Hobbies: At Playgroup, Madame Gazelle talks to the children about hobbies.
Rothar: Thíos ag an bpáirc, tá sé deacair ag Bluey foghlaim le rothaíocht a dhéanamh ar a rothar féin.
Bob Bilbí: Is é seans Bingo é an puipéad a thabhairt abhaile ón naíonra agus cuntas a thabhairt ar an deireadh seachtaine a bhíonn acu i ndialann an phuipéid.
Who left the door open, not me, who let the dog out?
Hedgie Hide and Seek: Pins and Nettie are playing a game of hide and seek but neither one of them like the pressure of being 'it'. So they come up with a new way to play.
Dylan the Hotel Cleaner wants to make his guest's bed cozy for bedtime - but when he accidentally washes the guest's stuffy, he's gonna have to... dry hard.
Dylan has to get creative when he does a spot of wedding planning.
Daniel can't wait to race the crafty car he made at school with Prince Wednesday! But Prince Wednesday is busy playing with Jodi now. Is Prince Wednesday still Daniel's friend?
When Banba's ranger gets stuck in some mud, the friends must work together to find a way to help him get unstuck.
Dee encourages a friend to say 'n', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see a nest, some noses and a net, and watch some newts eat noodles at night!
The Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.
Troys Little Trick: When the Buddies forget that they promised to play with Troy, he lures them to him - by making them think that a VroomBoard has come to life.
Oswaldo is the New Black: When Joubert turns a fun school trip into a boot camp, Leia and Oswaldo devise a way out.
Oswaldonet: After phones are confiscated by Joubert, Oswaldo creates a new social network: Oswaldonet.

programmes.show_name: Lex and Plu Space Taxi Drivers
programmes.show_description: Best Driver in the Universe: Lex and Plu are driving along and listening to their favourite band when they pick up a fare - and are amazed to discover they're driving the lead singer!
Hairdressers: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.
Stumpfest: Dad and his mates hit the backyard, ready to rip up some tree stumps! But when Bluey and Bingo take over a stump as a nail salon, Dad finds he's got some negotiating to do.
Born Yesterday: When Dad pretends he was born yesterday, Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth.
Mini Bluey: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey.
Cloud Ukulele Dance: Fuzzy Yellow and friends play 'Pull a Dance from a Hat,' but Moon worries about not being a good enough dancer. (SL)

Pablo can't find his Big Book of Animals, and needs to make sure that it is still exactly the same.
King thinks the Kingdom needs a queen, but Prince doesn't want his dad to remarry. Mouse and Dragon try to help him and scare off potential partners!
Salty's precious logbook has gone missing in which he wrote down everything that happened! All the evidence points to Puffin being the culprit.
Lily finds a little hoop washed up on the beach, which is just perfect for the Driftwood Bay Carnival. Lily and Bull decide to see how many prizes they can win.
The family discover a cave from 700AD and ride the rapids as they continue their adventure across America.
The family's US trip ends in Hollywood, where they visit a film and meet none other than Mr Potato and Hash brown.
Tá na Bheigíní caillte sa bhféar ard; cén chaoi ina rachaidh siad ar ais chun baile?
